_about: Refund and return amounts as ARCHITECTURE.md section 3 and USERS.md state them: a cancel and the 4:00 sweep move what an order locked into the owner's balance inside the book (D37, D99), and Return to owner pays that balance to the owner's own wallet (D99). Rows give the order, what it locked, and what comes back. A bid locks priceCents x quantity cents in USDC; an offer locks its Yes. USDC in base units (1e6 per dollar), prices in cents, tokens whole. The screen text is USERS.md's wording (D84 units). A frozen golden file: changing it is a logged decision.
